PC:
Diagnostics Indicated:
TSH, free T4, CBC, BMP, EKG, cardiac monitor

Therapy Indicated:
Beta blockers, Propylthiouracil (PTU) or Methimazole, Potassium iodide (after PTU or Methimazole), Glucocorticoids

Expected Learner Interventions
Recognize thyroid storm, give beta blockers, PTU or methimazole prior to iodide, start glucocorticoids, ICU or Medicine/Endocrine consultation for admission Fluid resuscitate for tachycardia with volume expander (Normal Saline or Lactated Ringer's Solution).
